title: On the robustness of the Multiscale Hybrid-Mixed finite element method
method: Polyline vertices from the vector PDF left panel; logarithmic ordinate calibrated with tick marks at 0.04 and 0.72; vertex series identified against Figure 6 legend.
ordinate_uncertainty: Plus/minus 1 PDF point vertically, mapped through logarithmic calibration; extraction allowance, not solver uncertainty.

printed_annotations.scope: Distinct observations from numeric text next to the face-enrichment curve in Figure 6, manuscript PDF page 28 (zero-based index 27 of 31). These do not replace the vector-digitized CSV ordinates or their extraction allowance.
printed_annotations.precision_convention: The text is transcribed to its five printed decimal places; it is neither an exact real-valued error nor a bound for reference/discretization uncertainty.
printed_annotations.unannotated_convention: The s=2 and s=8 ordinates remain vector-PDF extractions with the CSV uncertainty. No exact printed values are assigned to these two points.
